about_the_game:
Defendrion is a fast-paced, top-down action RPG where every stage is a battle for survival. Journey through handcrafted levels filled with relentless enemies, deadly ambushes, and powerful minibosses. Slay foes, gather XP, and customize your hero on the fly to face whatever the next level throws at you.

Forge Your Arsenal

Unlock elemental spells or evolve existing ones into devastating second-tier forms. Rain chain-lightning across an entire corridor, freeze hordes mid-charge, or conjure a swirling black hole that drags enemies to their doom.

  • Firebolt Upgrade – Turn a single flame into a scorching volley.

  • Electrocute Upgrade – Supercharge lightning so it chains through entire enemy squads.

Master Your Build

Each level-up grants attribute points to invest in Power, Resilience, Crit Chance, and more. Become a fragile glass cannon, an unbreakable tank, or a versatile battlemage—your playstyle is yours to define.

Level-by-Level Progression

Advance through dangerous stages where new enemy types, ambush patterns, and minibosses demand quick reflexes and fresh tactics. Conquer one level, push deeper, and face even greater challenges with bigger rewards.

Rewards That Matter

Clearing levels grants rare spell mods, unique buffs, and brag-worthy leaderboard scores. Skillful dodging, clever spell use, and strategic builds are the keys to progression.

Pick Up & Play, Tough to Master

Snappy twin-stick controls and fast-paced combat keep the action flowing. But beneath the immediacy lies deep build variety, spell synergies, and score-chasing mastery for players who want to push their limits.

Defendrion is all about the addictive loop: fight, evolve, and press forward into the next, deadlier stage. Will you survive long enough to uncover the ultimate power?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later (Universal: Apple Silicon & Intel)
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio–compatible, stereo (5.1 supported)
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple M2
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio–compatible, stereo (5.1 supported)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible, 5.1 surround supported
